s: Debugging an LLM's ability to manipulate web UIs via JSON responses led to a realization that the chat stream was unsuitable for DOM updates. Separating concerns by using Server-Sent Events (SSE) for DOM manipulation alongside WebSockets for chat proved to be the correct architectural pattern.
sub: WebSocket vs. Server-Sent Events (SSE) for UI Updates
Separation of Concerns in Real-time Web Apps
